Pict Example
Fileview Browser
pict-section-fileview

One pict-section-fileview embedded in an app shell and driven by the file list on the left. Click a file and the viewer re-points at it and dispatches to the right lens. Clicking from one image to the next is a same-kind re-point — the viewer re-feeds the live pict-section-image child in place (no teardown); clicking from an image to code is a type switch — the image child is destroyed and the code child mounted. The active lens is shown under the viewer.
